# Gallery

Rendered previews of every template in this repo. These are **full OpenSCAD
renders** (`openscad --render`) of the actual plate geometry.

Two views per pattern:
- **Flat** — top-down orthographic; white shows the slots cut clean through the plate.
- **3D** — a 3/4 perspective showing the plate thickness.

![All templates](_contact_sheet.png)

## Regenerating

Built by `make gallery` from the repo root (or `./build_gallery.sh` for just the
PNGs). Each template gets two `openscad --render` passes — a top-down ortho view
(`gallery/<name>.png`) and an angled perspective view (`gallery/<name>_3d.png`) —
then `montage` assembles `_contact_sheet.png`.

The table above is **auto-generated** by `gen_index.py` (via `make index`) from
the `// Description:` line in each `.scad` — edit those comments, not the table.
